headline: Jacobs to support clean transit expansion ahead of 2028 LA Olympic and Paralympic Games
summary: DALLAS, July 29, 2026--Jacobs selected to design and build advanced charging infrastructure at two of LA Metro’s Bus Divisions in the cities of Carson and West Hollywood.
